title: Senior BSA / Data Migration Specialist (Salesforce)
summary: Senior business systems analyst focused on Salesforce data migration. Plan and run the mapping, cleansing, and load cycles that move legacy data into Salesforce accurately. Based in Montreal or Toronto and open to candidates authorized to work in Canada.
responsibilities: Analyze legacy data sources and define field-level mapping into Salesforce objects.
Plan data cleansing, transformation, and validation rules with business owners.
Run migration test loads, reconcile results, and document defects through to resolution.
Prepare and execute cutover loads and post-migration verification.
requirements: Senior-level business systems analysis experience on Salesforce or CRM data projects.
Hands-on experience with migration tooling such as Salesforce Data Loader or comparable ETL tools.
Strong SQL or data-analysis skills for profiling and reconciliation.
niceToHave: Experience with large CRM consolidation or re-platforming projects.
